settings.heading: Built for the pack
settings.body:
Every garment is a small woodcut prayer for soft hearts who refuse to apologize. Premium heavyweight cotton. Distressed graphics. Made to last.

We started in a garage in Oak Park, Illinois with three blank tees and a pile of woodcuts. We've still never made anything we wouldn't wear ourselves.
